explanation: Reverse the entire character array, then reverse the characters of each resulting word.
correctness: The first reversal reverses word order and each word's letters. Reversing each word restores its spelling while leaving the new word order intact.
walkthrough: For foxes run fast, reversing all characters gives tsaf nur sexof. Reverse each space-delimited segment in that same array to restore the internal spelling, producing fast run foxes. Spaces remain separators and the array length is unchanged. JSON encodes the mutable character array as one string. The callable returns void/None/undefined; expected is the same array’s word-reversed content.
edgeCases: Empty input stays empty. A single word is reversed twice and finishes unchanged; unequal word lengths need no extra storage.
timeComplexity: O(n) time: one full reversal, one boundary scan, and word reversals whose total lengths sum to at most n.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space: all reversals swap within the original mutable character array; only range indices are stored.
